profile.name: Thomas Scheiber
profile.headline: Software & Automation Engineering | Internal Tools, Cloud Applications & Developer Platforms
profile.about:
I build software for internal operations: web applications, automation and tools that colleagues use to manage their work. At Refurbed, my work covers application development and deployment, identity integrations and endpoint automation.

I work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python and PowerShell. Recent projects include a Git and deployment platform pilot, an optional online Git course and an advisory AI code reviewer. I deploy internal applications to Google Cloud Run through GitLab CI/CD. My background in IT administration helps me understand the support and operational problems these tools need to solve.

I also build websites and applications as a freelance web developer. I hold a B.Sc. in Engineering in Smart Homes and Assistive Technologies from FH Technikum Wien and am studying for a master's in Software Engineering at TU Wien.
